basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati (IIT Guwahati) Project Scientist Notification 2026 has been released on the official website of IIT Guwahati. A total of 1 vacancy has been announced through the IIT Guwahati Project Scientist Recruitment 2026.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Guwahati Project Scientist Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 03-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Guwahati to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Guwahati Project Scientist position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Project Scientist position at IIT Guwahati is 03 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Scientist post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PhD degree in Organometallic Chemistry to be eligible for the Project Scientist position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Project Scientist role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Scientist position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 55,750 per month.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Project Scientist post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Scientist position at IIT Guwahati.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application for the IIT Guwahati Project Scientist recruitment must be submitted online through the official website.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Project Scientist position?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Scientist recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Scientist role at IIT Guwahati will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Project Scientist position at IIT Guwahati is a contractual job type.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of IIT Guwahati?
faq.answer: The official website of Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati is https://iitg.ac.in.
